1.consolidated_definition: El dental del arado antiguo recibió a través del país, en la investigación de Navarro, variados nombres: … senta(d)era (interior noroccidental). También cabeza, pico, púa y puya, cubo, hocico, hoza, trompa, punta.
1.en_consolidated_definition: The dental of the ancient plow received various names throughout the country, according to Navarro's research: senta(d)era (northern interior northwest). It was also referred to as head, beak, spike and spikelet, cube, snout, hoze, trunk, point.
